Name: Rustic Attic (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This adds a rustic little attic that grows with house upgrades using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]. Fully decoratable walls, decoration space and you can cask there as well.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it.
[b]
Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with everything including recolours (as long as they are properly updated for 1.6 - you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24487]this[/url] for Earthy Interiors for example).

[b]Credits
[/b]Inspired by the attic design in Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse.

[b]Mods used in screenshots[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]PCs Rattan Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27174]HxWs Decorative Plants Furniture Set[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and PIF. 1.6. is required.
